# Security (cms-admin)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`two-factor-setup`](../../flows/two-factor-setup/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

The API client and the shared confirmation form behind `/settings/security` and `/settings/password` ([two-factor-setup](../../flows/two-factor-setup/FLOW.md), [password](../../flows/password/FLOW.md)).

## Techniques

A feature module: an API factory registered through `Features.registry.ts` (`apiServices`), provided to pages by a React context; TanStack Query hooks for server data. `ConfirmWithCodeForm` asks for the current password plus a code (D8); `Security.errors.ts` maps each failure to a field to mark, a state change made elsewhere, or a form alert.

## Technologies

Axios, react-hook-form with Zod, `@abyss/form-commons`.

## Entry points

Facade `index.ts`: `ConfirmWithCodeForm`, `useSecurityApi`; `createSecurityApi` (TOTP setup, enable, disable, email code, password change).

## Where to change what

A new security call: `Security.api.ts` and its error mapping in `Security.errors.ts`. Pages import only the facade.
